clue.text: Concluded actors can be dull

parts.note: something concluded is over, finished
the actors in a production are its cast

explanation.surface: A remark that a company of performers may prove boring.
explanation.definitionFit: An overcast sky is grey and cloudy, so dull weather fits the adjective.

clue.text: Authority supremo's behind run getting cancelled regularly

indicators.note: the behind of a word is its rear, so take the final letter of supremo's

parts.note: R is the cricket scoring abbreviation for a run

indicators.note: taking every other letter at even intervals of the word cancelled

explanation.surface: A top boss's backing for some project fails, so it gets scrapped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes the second, fourth, sixth and eighth letters of 'cancelled', giving ACLE.
explanation.definitionFit: An oracle is a person regarded as an infallible authority on a subject.

clue.text: Resurrect variable buzz in drugs

indicators.note: the word in places one piece inside the other here

parts.note: E is slang for ecstasy, so two of them are EE
X is the classic algebraic variable
to buzz is to hum

explanation.surface: Bring something back to life with a varying hum while on pills.
explanation.definitionFit: To exhume is to dig up a buried body, so figuratively to revive or bring back.

clue.text: Trustworthy journalist in bed with the French

indicators.note: the word in puts the journalist inside the bed

parts.note: a crib is a child's bed
ED is short for editor, the stock crossword journalist
le is the French masculine word for the

explanation.surface: A reporter found sharing a bed with French people is considered reliable.
explanation.definitionFit: Something credible is believable, worthy of being trusted.

clue.text: Tory moderates back in bother

indicators.note: back means the word is read from right to left

parts.note: in British politics the wets were moderate Conservatives opposed to Thatcher's hard line

explanation.surface: Centrist Conservatives are in political trouble again.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in a stew is to be in a state of agitation or trouble, a bother.

clue.text: Comeback reaping reward

definitions.meaning: a coming back, as of a star or a season
a profit yielded by an investment, its yield

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a coming back and the profit an investment yields.

clue.text: Drunk on beer in dress, with pomp

indicators.note: someone drunk is all over the place, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A tipsy reveller in fancy dress, full of ceremony.
explanation.definitionFit: To enrobe is to dress someone in a robe, a ceremonial garment.

clue.text: United let injured Ferdinand recuperate initially in secret

parts.note: U is the abbreviation for United in team names

indicators.note: something injured is damaged, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: Rio Ferdinand was a Manchester United defender

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Manchester United let their injured defender recover away from the press.
explanation.walkthrough: 'injured' rearranges LET to LTE. RIO Ferdinand played centre-back for Manchester United.
explanation.definitionFit: An ulterior motive is a concealed one, kept secret beyond what is stated.

clue.text: Invaders formerly from North or South Yemen decapitated

parts.note: N is the compass abbreviation for north
S is the compass abbreviation for south

indicators.note: decapitated means the head letter is cut off

explanation.surface: Historic raiders came from northern or southern Yemen, minus their leaders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'decapitated' removes the Y from Yemen, leaving EMEN.
explanation.definitionFit: The Norsemen were the Vikings who raided and invaded Europe in the early Middle Ages.

clue.text: High-flier given a cold greeting at all times

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold on taps
hi is an informal greeting
ever means always

explanation.surface: A successful person is always met with an icy hello.
explanation.definitionFit: An achiever is someone successful, a high-flier who accomplishes a lot.

clue.text: Author is more sardonic given time

indicators.note: the wordy piece is given the time letter in its middle

parts.note: wrier is the comparative of wry, drily mocking

explanation.surface: A novelist grows drier and more mocking as the years pass.
explanation.definitionFit: An author is a writer of books or other works.

clue.text: Resistance stops yet note judge turn all nervous

indicators.note: every piece is turned round together, read right to left
the resistance letter plugs the gap within the word yet

parts.note: R is the physics symbol for resistance
ti is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Opposition still halts a judge's verdict, making everyone anxious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn all' reverses the whole assembled string YRETTIJ at once, not each piece separately.
explanation.definitionFit: Jittery means nervous and jumpy, full of the jitters.

clue.text: Weak identity becoming clear

parts.note: limp means weak, lacking firmness
ID is short for identity, as on a card

explanation.surface: A feeble sense of self gradually becoming transparent.
explanation.definitionFit: Limpid water is perfectly transparent, so the word means clear.

clue.text: 'Up Up And Away' tune endured

parts.note: an air is a melody
borne is the past participle of bear, to endure

explanation.surface: A famous song title described as a melody that stood the test of time.
explanation.definitionFit: Up, up and away describes something lifting off into the sky, flying.

clue.text: In short cheese attracts insect

parts.note: Brie is a soft French cheese
a fly is an insect

explanation.surface: Put simply, a ripe soft cheese draws flies.
explanation.definitionFit: Briefly means in a few words, in short.

clue.text: Plain speaking from sweet woman wanting husband but getting left

indicators.note: wanting means lacking, so the husband letter goes and the left letter takes its place

parts.note: Charity is a woman's name, and charity suggests sweet kindness

explanation.surface: Frankness from a lovely lady who has lost her spouse but been abandoned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wanting husband but getting left' swaps the H in CHARITY for L.
explanation.definitionFit: Clarity in speech is clearness of expression, so plain speaking.

clue.text: Socks and shoe repaired

indicators.note: repaired means put back together in a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Hosiery and footwear brought in for mending.
explanation.definitionFit: Hose is an old collective word for stockings and socks.

clue.text: Speed up cuts

definitions.meaning: chops repeated, as with an axe

explanation.definitionFit: The doubled word is slang for hurry up, and literally two chops or cuts.

clue.text: Back-to-back compositions put in flipside

parts.note: op is short for opus, a musical composition

indicators.note: two pieces placed back to back, so the second faces the other way

parts.note: the second opus, read backwards
to site something is to put it in place

explanation.surface: Two records released consecutively, placed on the B-side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Back-to-back' sets the two opuses facing away from each other, so the second is read backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The opposite is the other side, the flipside of something.

clue.text: Expressing emotion and energy opening of 'Famous Five' enthrals us

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter
enthrals means holds captive, so the word five surrounds us

explanation.surface: Gushing about the vigour of the start of a famous children's adventure series.
explanation.walkthrough: The Famous Five are Enid Blyton's child adventurers; 'enthrals' wraps the number around the pronoun.
explanation.definitionFit: Effusive means gushing, pouring out feeling without restraint.

clue.text: 'Shop Around' bringing to mind teenage dances

indicators.note: around means moved about, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A classic pop song title evokes memories of youthful discos.
explanation.walkthrough: Shop Around is a 1960 Miracles hit, so the quoted title is a period touch.
explanation.definitionFit: A hop is an informal dance, the classic teenage record hop.

clue.text: Pratchett covers provided shock

indicators.note: covers means the name goes around the other piece

parts.note: Terry Pratchett wrote the Discworld novels
if means provided that

explanation.surface: A fantasy author's book jackets are startling, as long as you look.
explanation.definitionFit: To terrify is to frighten greatly, to shock.

clue.text: A rest for potter and spinner

definitions.meaning: in snooker, a potter of balls uses a cue rest with raised legs
an eight-legged creature that spins webs

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a long-legged snooker cue rest and the web-spinning arachnid.

clue.text: 'Dandy' encompassing the Spanish for 'fool'

indicators.note: encompassing means surrounding the other piece

parts.note: a dude is a dandy, a fop
el is the Spanish masculine word for the

explanation.surface: A fop around Spaniards is a buffoon.
explanation.definitionFit: To delude someone is to deceive them, to fool them.

clue.text: Wordplay's clear, its contents seasonal?

parts.note: a pun is wordplay on a word's double sense
net means clear, as in clear profit after deductions

explanation.surface: A joke's meaning is obvious, and its subject matter is topical.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is cryptic: a punnet's contents are seasonal soft fruit such as strawberries.
explanation.definitionFit: A punnet is a small basket for summer berries, so what it holds is seasonal.

clue.text: Cue line — last in play — without further ado

parts.note: a prompt is a cue to an actor

indicators.note: last in means the final letter of the word

explanation.surface: A theatre prompter gives the final speech in the drama immediately.
explanation.definitionFit: Promptly means at once, without delay or further ado.

clue.text: Office furniture

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a government department and a desk with drawers.

clue.text: Good affordable starter home generating profit

indicators.note: a starter comes first, so the initial letter of the word

parts.note: in means at home

explanation.surface: A cheap first house earns money for the buyer.
explanation.definitionFit: A gain is an increase or profit.

clue.text: Barnet musical event

parts.note: Hair is the 1960s rock musical
a do is a party or event

explanation.surface: A show in a north London suburb.
explanation.walkthrough: Barnet is a London borough, but it is also Cockney rhyming slang: Barnet Fair means hair.
explanation.definitionFit: Barnet is Cockney rhyming slang for a head of hair, a style of it.

clue.text: Understood cry of sea-eagle is silent

parts.note: tacit means understood without being stated

indicators.note: a cry is something uttered out loud, so the bird's name is heard rather than seen

parts.note: the erne is the white-tailed sea eagle

explanation.surface: A bird's call is grasped while it stays quiet.
explanation.definitionFit: Taciturn means reserved, saying little, silent by nature.

clue.text: Master of the macabre's attempt to create verse

parts.note: Edgar Allan Poe was the master of the macabre tale
a try is an attempt

explanation.surface: A horror writer has a go at writing rhymes.
explanation.definitionFit: Verse is metrical writing, the stuff of poems.

clue.text: Return engagement

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both the yield on savings and absorbed involvement or attention.
